interface.longDescription: AI-driven multi-format SVG content generation system. Converts source documents (PDF/DOCX/URL/Markdown) into high-quality SVG pages and exports to PPTX through multi-role collaboration. Use when user asks to "create PPT", "make presentation", "生成PPT", "做PPT", "制作演示文稿", or mentions "ppt-master".
